$meta.note: One entry per cutout in 00-assets/cutouts/. All files are true alpha PNGs from removebg exports, black and white baked in (grayscale, contrast 1.18, brightness .88), cropped to the alpha bounding box. Never scale a cutout above its width × height. ground excludes navy where dark clothing would disappear. grammar records exclusions under cover-grammar.md; user-approved entries override a grammar exclusion at the owner's request.
$meta.processing: 6 September 2026: the original keyed set (flattened renders keyed on white) removed entirely. Sixteen true cutouts installed; fig-runner-side and fig-runner-bottle removed without replacement.
